defects.basis: TASK.md: apply.workable.com/j/<shortcode> links a job, not an account, so it is no board; a percent-encoded form of the same path (%6a) is the same link
existing behaviour: at base a Greenhouse link whose token case-folds to a valid one (a Kelvin sign folding to k) names that board; moving the slug check must not break it
